issue_request: FHIR-27038 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking to update the definition/description of PlanDefinition.action.title to say it is the textual description displayed to a user, with an example that a test action title could be Assay by HPLC.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied in git commit 910a2256446d1b85ebcbbe618cbe3a4255ad05c0, which updated source/plandefinition/plandefinition-spreadsheet.xml for a group of FDA-PQ/CMC PlanDefinition documentation issues. That commit changed PlanDefinition.action.title from the older shorter wording to the requested text and example.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The later build-core source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 retained the FHIR-27038 wording in source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml, and 086649a235 retained the same text in the mapping exception file. Jira searches for PlanDefinition.action.title and Assay by HPLC found only FHIR-27038; Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current StructureDefinition source already implements the requested definition.
